name: Change plan contact
description: Add or replace a plan contact (e.g. new plan administrator).

steps.name: Validate contact change request
steps.guidance: The request must include the role, name and email of the new contact.

steps.name: Verify request came from an authorized contact
steps.guidance: Contact changes are a common fraud vector. Call back the current plan administrator using the number on file, not one supplied in the request.
checklist: Call-back to number on file completed
Requester is a current authorized contact

steps.name: Update contact on recordkeeper
steps.guidance: Replaces the contact for the given role and syncs to the recordkeeper.

steps.name: Confirm change to old and new contact
steps.guidance: Notify both the new and the previous contact so an unauthorized change is noticed quickly.
